dataset: MMLU-Pro (TIGER-Lab/MMLU-Pro 'default' test), MedMCQA (openlifescienceai/medmcqa train + validation; the unlabelled test split is not used) and MedQA-USMLE 4-option (GBaker/MedQA-USMLE-4-options train + test), read via the HF datasets-server parquet API on the run date. Stem polarity: 'neg' when the question's last sentence (split after . ? ! + whitespace) matches not|except|false|incorrect|untrue|least or n't as a whole word, case-insensitive. Meta option: first word all|none|both|neither and at most 6 words. Lengths are Unicode code points after str.strip().
note: pick_longest / pick_shortest: tie-aware accuracy of picking the longest / shortest option without reading the question. chance: mean 1/k. lift: pick_longest - chance; se_lift: its standard error over questions. contrasts: negative-stem lift minus positive-stem lift with a two-sample z. meta_share: share of questions with an all/none/both-style option. Construction property only; no model is evaluated.
